Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 2002
CUSTOMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the, Customs Act, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
28th March, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002/Pub., dated 28-3-2002.--The following Ordinance
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be caked
the Customs (Amendment) Ordinance; 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of First Schedule, Act IV of 1969

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 2002
CUSTOMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the, Customs Act, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
28th March, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002/Pub., dated 28-3-2002.--The following Ordinance
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of First Schedule, Act IV of 1969.--In the Customs
Act, 1969 (IV of 1969), in the First Schedule, in section IV in Chapter 17, in
heading No. 1701, against sub-heading Nos. 1701.1100 and 1701.1200 in column
(1) in column (3) for the figure "20%" the figure "30%"
shall be substituted.
